title: 人民币国际化提速：美国制裁反成机会，窗口期来了？
speaker: Andrew Tilton

segments.en: I want to pick up on that point that you made about the Remembee internationalization. What we have seen this year is Beijing moving beyond symbolic milestones to really starting to build some of the scaffolding that allows international players to hold Remembee,
segments.zh: 我想接着你提到的人民币国际化这一点。今年我们看到北京超越了象征性里程碑，真正开始搭建让国际参与者持有人民币的框架，

segments.en: hedge it, and so on at scale. Do you see a sort of unprecedented push to internationalize the UN this year? Are we reaching a tipping point for that push?
segments.zh: 进行对冲等规模化操作。你认为今年是否出现了前所未有的推动人民币国际化的努力？我们是否正达到这一推动的临界点？

segments.en: Absolutely. It's very clear that Chinese authorities have stepped this into a higher gear over the past year or so, both in terms of building out the plumbing as it were of a broader internationalization of the Remembee.
segments.zh: 绝对如此。很明显，中国当局在过去一年左右加快了步伐，在构建人民币更广泛国际化的基础设施方面。

segments.en: A number of things just rolled out in recent months, R&B repo, foreign central banks, a number of various, of course the connect programs over time building out more of a financial center here for trading Remembee.
segments.zh: 近几个月推出了一系列举措，人民币回购、外国央行，当然还有随时间推进的互联互通计划，在这里建设更多人民币交易金融中心。

segments.en: We've got parallel actions in the commodity space. They're working on building out a commodity exchange. A lot of things happening in the plumbing of the broader financial system that are going to be relevant.
segments.zh: 我们在商品领域也有并行行动。他们正在建设商品交易所。更广泛金融体系的基础设施中正在发生许多相关的事情。

segments.en: It also appears they see an opportunity with the U.S. having utilized dollar sanctions and financial sanctions more aggressively in recent years that may create an opportunity for countries less aligned with the U.S.
segments.zh: 看来他们也看到了机会，因为美国近年来更积极地使用美元制裁和金融制裁，这可能为与美国立场不一致的国家创造机会。

segments.en: or concern that they could be the target of those sanctions who are looking for alternatives, looking perhaps to diversify, I think Chinese policymakers view this as a window of opportunity.
segments.zh: 或担心可能成为制裁目标的国家正在寻找替代方案，或许寻求多元化，我认为中国政策制定者将此视为机会窗口。
